detaileddescription.para: The UART driver provides API to configure the UART module. Below are the high level features supported by the UART driver.

listitem.para: Standard asynchronous communication bits for start, stop, and parity
16-level, 8-wide Transmit and Receive FIFOs with fine-grained FIFO configuration (trigger configurable at any level 0-16)
Support for line-break generation and detection, IrDA serial-IR (SIR) encoder and decoder

simplesect.para: It is strongly recommend to use SysConfig where it is available instead of using direct SW API calls. This will help simplify the SW application and also catch common mistakes early in the development cycle.

listitem.para: Baud rate calculator with error estimation
Fully programmable serial interface characteristics (start, stop, and parity bits)
Separately configurable TX & RX FIFO settings
Integrated support for interrupt & RTDMA modules
Avoid keeping the memory browser open while the execution is in progress, as this can lead to erroneous reads from the UART data register

sect1.title: Example Usage
sect1.para: Include the below file to access the APIs #include <uart.h>
